words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.ex: You are my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 你是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Used to refer to the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

chapters.name: 附录2 TOEFL 考试常见熟词僻义列表

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: vt. 逮捕；拘留；阻止；“arrest”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被捕的；被拘留的；
words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest someone, they take them away to ask them about a crime that they might have committed.

words.ex: He can articulate his ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他能清楚地表达自己的想法。
words.en: If you describe someone as articulate, you mean that they are able to express their thoughts and ideas easily and clearly.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: The default setting is on.
words.ex_cn: 默认设置是开启的。
words.en: If a person, company, or country defaults on something that they have legally agreed to do, such as paying a debt or keeping to an agreement, they fail to do it.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: He exploited the situation to get more money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用这个情况赚了更多钱。
words.en: To exploit someone or something means to use them in a way that benefits you, often unfairly or without considering their rights or feelings. It can also refer to the act of making full use of and deriving benefit from a resource.

words.tr: n. 阐述者；拥护者；代表者；指数
words.ex: He is the exponent of modern education reform.
words.ex_cn: 他是现代教育改革的阐述者。
words.en: An exponent is someone who supports and explains a particular idea, theory, or system, or a symbol that shows how many times a number is to be multiplied by itself.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.tr: v. 感到；认为；“feel”的过去式和过去分词； n. 毛毡；毡制品；
words.ex: I felt happy when I saw my friend.
words.ex_cn: 当我见到我的朋友时，我感到开心。
words.en: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr: adj. 功能的；起作用的；实用的；
words.ex: This chair is functional and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子功能性强且舒适。
words.en: Relating to the way in which something works or operates.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.ex: His humor makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.tr: v. 邀请；“invite”的现在分词； adj. 诱人的；吸引人的；
words.ex: He is inviting his friends to dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在邀请他的朋友来吃晚饭。
words.en: If you describe something as inviting, you mean that it has good qualities that attract you or make you want to experience it.

words.tr: adj. 有关的；有牵连的；繁杂的； v. 包括；牵涉；“involve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is involved in the school project.
words.ex_cn: 他与这个学校项目有关。
words.en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it complicated or difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: The dinosaur lived in a long period ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙生活在很久以前的一个时期。
words.en: A period is a length of time in which something happens, or a stretch of time with a particular quality or characteristic.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.tr: v. 发音；宣告；“pronounce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 显著的；
words.ex: He pronounced the word correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地发音了这个单词。
words.en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable or obvious.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.ex: The soldiers were given quarters near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们被安排在基地附近的住处。
words.en: Quarters can refer to one of four equal parts into which something is divided, a period of three months, a period of 15 minutes, or a place where someone lives or stays.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: He will retire next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将退休。
words.en: If you retire, you stop working, usually because you have reached a certain age or because you are ill.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: He got high scores in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or by a team or an individual.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.tr:
adj. 唯一的；
n. 鞋底；
words.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。
words.en: If you describe something as the sole thing of a particular kind, you mean that it is the only one of that kind.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: He spoke to his friend yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天和他的朋友说了话。
words.en: A spoke is one of the rods or bars that connect the center of a wheel to its outer edge, helping to support the wheel's structure.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天花朵盛开。
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.tr: n. 中风；划水动作；一击；
words.ex: He had a stroke last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年中风了。
words.en: A stroke is a medical condition in which poor blood flow to the brain results in cell death. It can also refer to an act of hitting or striking someone or something, or a gentle movement of the hand over a surface.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: The baby ate the tender broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝吃了嫩的西兰花。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as tender, you mean that they are kind, gentle, and sympathetic. If meat or other food is tender, it is easy to cut or chew. To tender something such as a service or a resignation means to formally offer or present it.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: It was an utter mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个完全的错误。
words.en: To say something or to make a sound with your voice; complete or absolute.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: He receives his wage every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A wage is the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for manual or unskilled work. To wage means to carry on (a war or campaign).

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

chapters.name: 附录3 TOEFL 考试常见词组及搭配

words.ex: A cluster of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount; to a great extent.

words.ex: You need a minimum of five apples to make the pie.
words.ex_cn: 做这个派至少需要五个苹果。
words.en: At least; not less than.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: He has the ability to do math quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有快速做数学的能力。
words.en: The physical or mental power or skill needed to do something.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He acted on the advice and got better.
words.ex_cn: 他按照建议做了，结果好多了。
words.en: To do something as a result of information or advice received.

words.ex: As far as is known, he lives in London.
words.ex_cn: 据所知，他住在伦敦。
words.en: To the extent that information is available.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.ex: The ground is bare of grass.
words.ex_cn: 地面没有草。
words.en: Lacking or stripped of something, especially a covering or decoration.

words.ex: He is able to swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: The fish adapted to the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼适应了冷水。
words.en: If something is adapted to a particular situation or purpose, it is especially suitable for it.

words.tr: phrase. 因...而受感激；因...而受欢迎
words.ex: She is appreciated for her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她因善良而受到赞赏。
words.en: to be grateful for something because of its value or the effort someone has put into it

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability or skill to do something.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.ex: He is considered to be a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是一位好老师。
words.en: If someone or something is considered to be a particular thing, they are regarded as that thing.

words.ex: He is credited with inventing the new machine.
words.ex_cn: 他因发明这台新机器而受到赞誉。
words.en: If someone is credited with something, they are officially recognized as having done it or as having a particular quality.

words.ex: He is dedicated to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他致力于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To be committed to a task or purpose; to devote oneself to a cause or activity.

words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.tr: phrase. 依赖于……的；取决于……的
words.ex: The plant is dependent upon sunlight to grow.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物依赖阳光生长。
words.en: Reliant on or determined by something else.

words.ex: The formula is derived from simple math rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式是从简单的数学规则推导出来的。
words.en: If you say that something is derived from something else, you mean that it comes from that thing.

words.ex: He is destined to become a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他注定会成为一名优秀的老师。
words.en: If you say that someone is destined to do something, you mean that it seems certain to happen because it has been decided by fate or by a higher power.

words.ex: The class is divided into two groups.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级被分成两个小组。
words.en: To be separated into parts or sections.

words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex: He is famous for singing beautiful songs.
words.ex_cn: 他因演唱动听的歌曲而闻名。
words.en: be widely known or recognized for a particular quality or achievement

words.ex: The room is filled with laughter.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了笑声。
words.en: To have a lot of a particular quality or thing.

words.ex: He was forced to do his homework after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后被迫做作业。
words.en: To be compelled or required to do something against one's will.

words.ex: Fish are found in rivers and lakes.
words.ex_cn: 鱼存在于河流和湖泊中。
words.en: To be located or present in a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He is inclined to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他倾向于早起。
words.en: If you are inclined to do something, you want to do it or you are likely to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: He is known for his kindness.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: If someone or something is known for a particular quality or feature, they are famous or recognized because of it.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: He is noted for his clear explanations.
words.ex_cn: 他以清晰的讲解而闻名。
words.en: To be famous or well known for a particular quality, feature, or achievement.

words.ex: The data was obtained from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据是从调查中获得的。
words.en: acquired or received from a specific source

words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: have its origin or beginning in a particular place or thing

words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: He is subjected to loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都要遭受巨大的噪音。
words.en: To experience something, often something unpleasant or unwanted.

words.ex: He is suited for the job because he is careful and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他适合这份工作，因为他细心又耐心。
words.en: To be appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose, person, or situation.

words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 典型的；有代表性的
words.ex: This behavior is typical of children his age.
words.ex_cn: 这种行为是他这个年龄的孩子典型的。
words.en: If something is typical of a particular type of thing, it has the usual qualities or features of that type.

words.ex: This book is valuable for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语很有价值。
words.en: be of great worth, importance, or usefulness for a purpose

words.ex: He is viewed as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被视为一位好老师。
words.en: To be considered or regarded in a particular way.

words.tr: v. 编织；编制；“weave”的过去分词；
words.ex: She woven a blanket with colorful threads.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩色线编织了一条毯子。
words.en: Made by weaving; interwoven.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.ex: He tried to break away from his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他试图摆脱旧习惯。
words.en: To leave or escape from a group, place, or situation, especially in order to start something new or different.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 接近；逼近；包围；关闭（门等）时挤伤…
words.ex: The train is close on the station.
words.ex_cn: 火车快要到站了。
words.en: To approach or come near to achieving something or reaching an agreement.

words.ex: He close upon the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握紧绳子。
words.en: To approach or come near to something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；举行；实现；成功；从…掉下
words.ex: He will come off the train at the next station.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下一站下车。
words.en: To happen or occur, especially in a particular way; to be successful or effective.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个小村庄。
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: He will comment on the game after it ends.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他会对此发表评论。
words.en: To express an opinion or reaction about something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: Happiness consists in simple moments.
words.ex_cn: 幸福在于简单的时刻。
words.en: If you say that something consists in a particular thing, you mean that the thing mentioned is the main or essential feature of it.

words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.tr: 短语动词. 不造成伤害；不做有害之事
words.ex: The doctor does no harm to his patients.
words.ex_cn: 医生不伤害他的病人。
words.en: To refrain from causing injury or damage to others.

words.ex: He tries to focus attention on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他努力把注意力集中在作业上。
words.en: To direct one's attention or efforts towards a particular subject or activity.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.ex: He gave up doing sports because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了而放弃了运动。
words.en: To stop doing something that you do regularly, especially something that is bad for you.

words.tr: phrase. 授予某人某物；准许某人某事
words.ex: The teacher granted him extra time to finish the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了他额外的时间来完成考试。
words.en: To give or allow someone something, usually in an official way.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: He called me in connection with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他因会议的事给我打了电话。
words.en: If something happens in connection with something else, it is related to it in some way.

words.ex: The boy is in danger of falling off the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩有从树上掉下来的危险。
words.en: If someone or something is in danger of something unpleasant happening, they are in a situation where it is possible or likely that it will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 向...表示敬意；为祝贺...
words.ex: They planted a tree in honor of her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她的生日。
words.en: If something is arranged or happens in honor of a particular event or person, it is done to celebrate that event or to show respect and admiration for that person.

words.tr: phrase. 在世界上；实际上；本质上
words.ex: Dolphins in nature are very smart.
words.ex_cn: 世界上海豚非常聪明。
words.en: In the essential character of something; in reality.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.ex: This book is about plants, with relation to their growth.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于植物及其生长的。
words.en: in connection with; concerning

words.ex: He smiled in response to her question.
words.ex_cn: 他针对她的问题笑了。
words.en: as a reply or reaction to something

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: He is late in that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他没赶上公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: I will go to college in the future.
words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.ex: Don't interfere with my work.
words.ex_cn: 不要干涉我的工作。
words.en: To interfere with something means to prevent it from happening or developing as it should, often by causing a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He works hard to meet his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To achieve or reach a specific aim or objective that one has set for oneself.

words.ex: He is a native of London.
words.ex_cn: 他是伦敦人。
words.en: A native of a particular place is someone who was born in that place.

words.ex: He was late on account of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车。
words.en: Because of something; due to something.

words.ex: Water plays a key role in keeping plants alive.
words.ex_cn: 水在维持植物生命中起着关键作用。
words.en: To have an important part in something.

words.ex: Wear a helmet to protect your head against injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴上头盔以保护头部免受伤害。
words.en: guard or defend something or someone from harm or danger

words.ex: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 戴帽子以保护你的脸免受阳光照射。
words.en: keep something or someone safe from harm or danger

words.tr: phrase. 在…到…的范围间变动
words.ex: The prices range from $5 to $20.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到20美元不等。
words.en: If things range from one thing to another, they vary within these limits on a scale of measurement or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: phrase. 依靠；搁在；停留在；基于
words.ex: The bridge must rest on strong pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥必须依靠坚固的支柱。
words.en: To depend or rely on something for support or as a basis.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: This room can serve as a meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间可以充当会议室。
words.en: To function or be used as something.

words.ex: He set about cleaning the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完早餐后开始打扫房间。
words.en: To start doing something, especially something that needs a lot of effort or time.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.ex: The children spread out on the grass to play.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在草地上铺开玩耍。
words.en: To extend over a large or increasing area.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他努力每天完成作业。
words.en: make a great effort to achieve something

words.ex: He succeeded to a great extent because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他非常成功，因为他努力工作。
words.en: To a very large degree; mostly.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: He used up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的水都用完了。
words.en: To consume or exhaust something completely.

words.ex: The new technology will usher in a better future.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将开启一个更美好的未来。
words.en: To usher in something means to be at the start of a new period, especially one that involves important changes or improvements.

chapters.name: 附录4 逆向分类词汇表

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: He loves to watch the cosmos at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在夜晚观看宇宙。
words.en: The cosmos refers to the universe seen as a well-ordered whole, or to any system or structure that is complex and orderly.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.ex: The telescope saw cosmic dust in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中看到了宇宙尘埃。
words.en: Cosmic dust consists of small particles in space, which are remnants from the formation of the solar system and other cosmic events.

words.ex: The cosmic inventory includes stars, planets, and distant galaxies.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙万物包括恒星、行星和遥远的星系。
words.en: A comprehensive list or catalog of cosmic entities and phenomena, compiled for the purpose of study and understanding of the universe.

words.ex: The moon is a celestial body.
words.ex_cn: 月亮是一个天体。
words.en: A celestial body is any natural body outside the Earth's atmosphere, such as the Moon, the Sun, an asteroid, planet, or star.

words.ex: He studies celestial mechanics to understand how planets move.
words.ex_cn: 他研究天体力学来理解行星是如何运动的。
words.en: Celestial mechanics is the branch of astronomy that deals with the motions of celestial objects and the effects of their gravitational interactions.

words.ex: He studies mechanical astronomy to understand how planets move.
words.ex_cn: 他研究天体力学以了解行星是如何运动的。
words.en: The branch of astronomy that deals with the application of the principles of mechanics to the motions of celestial bodies.

words.tr: n. 宇宙起源论；天体演化论
words.ex: He reads about cosmogony in his science book.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学书中阅读关于宇宙起源的内容。
words.en: The study of the origins of the universe or the cosmos, especially in a mythological or religious context.

words.ex: The Milky Way is our home galaxy.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是我们所在的星系。
words.en: A galaxy is an extremely large group of stars and planets that extends over many billions of light years.

words.ex: The telescope detected an extragalactic system far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜探测到一个远离地球的河外星系。
words.en: An extragalactic system refers to any system that exists outside of our own Milky Way galaxy, encompassing galaxies, galaxy clusters, and other cosmic structures.

words.ex: The metagalaxy contains billions of stars and planets.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙包含数十亿颗恒星和行星。
words.en: The metagalaxy refers to the largest-scale structure of the universe, encompassing all galaxies and galaxy clusters.

words.ex: The Milky Way is a galactic system with billions of stars.
words.ex_cn: 银河系是一个拥有数十亿颗恒星的银河系。
words.en: A galactic system refers to a large system of stars, dust, and gas held together by gravitational attraction, such as the Milky Way.

words.ex: The milky way is bright in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 银河在夜空中很明亮。
words.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System, with the name describing the galaxy's appearance from Earth: a hazy band of light seen in the night sky formed from stars that cannot be individually distinguished by the naked eye.

words.ex: The Earth is part of the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 地球是太阳系的一部分。
words.en: The solar system is the collection of eight planets and their moons in orbit around the Sun, together with smaller bodies in the form of asteroids, meteoroids, comets, and dwarf planets.

words.ex: The spaceship travels through interstellar space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船在星际空间中航行。
words.en: The region of space between the stars of a galaxy.

words.ex: The telescope shows a bright star cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示出一个明亮的恒星群。
words.en: A group of stars that are held together by gravitational attraction and are relatively close to each other in space.

words.ex: The telescope showed a bright stellar cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示出一个明亮的恒星团。
words.en: A stellar cluster is a group of stars that are gravitationally bound and typically formed from the same giant molecular cloud.

words.ex: The night sky sparkled with star dust.
words.ex_cn: 夜空闪烁着星尘。
words.en: fine particles of matter in space, often associated with stars

words.ex: The telescope showed a bright nebula in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示了一个明亮的星云。
words.en: A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky either as an indistinct bright patch or as a dark silhouette against other luminous matter.

words.ex: The stars shine brightly at night.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜晚明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Stars are celestial bodies that appear as points of light in the night sky. They are massive, luminous spheres of plasma held together by gravity.

words.ex: The young starlet became famous after her first movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻小星星在出演第一部电影后成名了。
words.en: A starlet is a young actress who is beginning to be noticed in films or television.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.ex: The fixed star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 那颗恒星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A fixed star is a star that appears to remain in the same position in the sky relative to the other stars, as seen from Earth, over a period of time.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: A bright meteor flashed across the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 一颗明亮的流星划过夜空。
words.en: A meteor is a piece of rock or metal that burns very brightly when it enters the earth's atmosphere from space.

words.ex: We saw a shooting star last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看到一颗流星。
words.en: A shooting star is a meteor that burns brightly as it enters the earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: She saw a falling star last night.
words.ex_cn: 她昨晚看到一颗流星。
words.en: A falling star is a meteor that burns up as it enters the earth's atmosphere, creating a bright streak of light in the night sky.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The telescope detected a minor planet far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜发现了一颗远离地球的小行星。
words.en: A minor planet is an astronomical object in direct orbit around the Sun that is neither a planet nor exclusively classified as a comet.

words.ex: The asteroid flew past Earth safely.
words.ex_cn: 这颗小行星安全地从地球旁飞过。
words.en: An asteroid is a small rocky body orbiting the sun. Large numbers of these, ranging enormously in size, are found between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, though some have more eccentric orbits.

words.ex: The small planetoid orbits the sun far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这个小行星体在远离地球的地方绕太阳运行。
words.en: A planetoid is a small celestial body that orbits the Sun, typically found in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: The quasar is very far away and very bright.
words.ex_cn: 这个类星体非常遥远且非常明亮。
words.en: A quasar is a massive and extremely remote celestial object, emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy, and typically having a star-like image in a telescope.

words.ex: The quasi-stellar object is very far from Earth.
words.ex_cn: 这个类星体离地球非常远。
words.en: A quasi-stellar object (QSO) is a very luminous active galactic nucleus, powered by a supermassive black hole at its center. QSOs are among the most energetic and distant objects in the universe.

words.tr: abbr. 类星体；“Quasi - Stellar Object”的缩写
words.ex: The telescope detected a qso billions of light-years away.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜探测到了数十亿光年外的一个类星体。
words.en: A conversation between two or more amateur radio operators.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.ex: Venus is the brightest planet in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。
words.en: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days. It is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

words.ex: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
words.ex_cn: 木星是我们太阳系中最大的行星。
words.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system, known for its prominent Great Red Spot and numerous moons.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.ex: Saturn has beautiful rings around it.
words.ex_cn: 土星周围有美丽的光环。
words.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and is known for its prominent ring system, which is composed mainly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.ex: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 天王星是离太阳第七远的行星。
words.en: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It has the third-largest planetary radius and fourth-largest planetary mass in the Solar System.

words.tr: n. 海王星；（罗马神话）海神尼普顿
words.ex: Neptune is the eighth planet from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 海王星是离太阳第八远的行星。
words.en: Neptune is the eighth and farthest known planet from the Sun in the Solar System. It is the fourth-largest planet by diameter, the third-most-massive planet, and the densest giant planet.

words.ex: Pluto is a dwarf planet far from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冥王星是离太阳很远的一颗矮行星。
words.en: Pluto is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt, a ring of bodies beyond Neptune.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.ex: The solar spectrum shows different colors of light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳光谱显示了不同颜色的光。
words.en: The solar spectrum is the spectrum of electromagnetic radiation emitted by the Sun, extending from the ultraviolet through the visible to the infrared.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: The sunspot appeared on the surface of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 太阳黑子出现在太阳表面。
words.en: A sunspot is a relatively dark area on the surface of the sun, which is cooler than its surroundings and associated with strong magnetic activity.

words.ex: The astronomer observed a large macula on the surface of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 天文学家观察到太阳表面有一个大的太阳黑子。
words.en: A small area of the retina that is responsible for central vision and the ability to see fine detail.

words.ex: The solar particle hit the Earth's atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 太阳粒子击中了地球的大气层。
words.en: A solar particle is a charged particle emitted by the Sun, often as part of the solar wind or during solar flares.

words.ex: We saw a solar eclipse last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天看到了日食。
words.en: A solar eclipse occurs when the moon passes between the sun and the earth, blocking all or part of the sun's light.

words.ex: The sun's corona is visible during a total solar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的日冕在日全食时可见。
words.en: The outermost part of the sun's atmosphere, visible as a white halo during a total solar eclipse.

words.ex: The solar corona is visible during a total solar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 日全食期间可以看到日冕。
words.en: The solar corona is the outermost part of the Sun's atmosphere, which is usually hidden by the bright light of the Sun's surface. It can be seen during a total solar eclipse.

words.ex: Galileo supported heliocentricism against the church's belief.
words.ex_cn: 伽利略支持日心说，反对教会的信仰。
words.en: The belief or theory that the sun is the center of the universe and that the Earth and other planets revolve around it.

words.ex: Ancient people believed in geocentricism.
words.ex_cn: 古人相信地心说。
words.en: The belief that the Earth is the center of the universe and that the sun, planets, and stars revolve around it.

words.ex: The moon shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮在夜空中明亮地照耀。
words.en: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.

words.ex: The children saw the full moon last night.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们昨晚看到了满月。
words.en: The phase of the moon in which its whole disk is illuminated.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.tr:
v. 衰落；减弱；缺；亏
n. 衰退；减弱；缺；亏
words.ex: The moon begins to wane after the full moon.
words.ex_cn: 满月之后，月亮开始变暗。
words.en: If something wanes, it becomes gradually weaker or less, often so that it eventually disappears.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: The moon turned red during the lunar eclipse.
words.ex_cn: 在月食期间，月亮变成了红色。
words.en: A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth moves between the Sun and the Moon, blocking the Sun's light from reaching the Moon.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: The rotation of teachers helps the school run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 教师的轮换有助于学校顺利运行。
words.en: Rotation refers to the action of rotating around an axis or center.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.ex: The satellite moves in an orbital path around Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星在围绕地球的轨道上运行。
words.en: Relating to an orbit or orbits.

words.ex: The star fell into a black hole.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星落入了一个黑洞。
words.en: A black hole is a region of space having a gravitational field so intense that no matter or radiation can escape.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The infrared ray warms the skin.
words.ex_cn: 红外线温暖皮肤。
words.en: Infrared rays are electromagnetic waves with wavelengths longer than visible light but shorter than microwaves, used in various applications such as thermal imaging and communication.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.ex: Scientists study the earth's core to understand earthquakes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究地球的核心以了解地震。
words.en: The central part of the earth, beneath the mantle, consisting of a solid inner core and a molten outer core.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The snow falls in the northern hemisphere in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，雪落在北半球。
words.en: The northern hemisphere is the half of Earth that is north of the equator. It contains about 68% of Earth's land and is home to the majority of the human population.

words.tr: phrase. 地磁场；地球的磁性区域，由地球内部的液态外核产生的电流所形成，对地球上的生物和导航系统具有重要影响
words.ex: The geomagnetic field protects Earth from solar wind.
words.ex_cn: 地磁场保护地球免受太阳风的影响。
words.en: The Earth's magnetic field, which extends from the Earth's interior out into space, where it meets the solar wind, a stream of charged particles emanating from the Sun.

words.ex: The earth rotation causes day and night.
words.ex_cn: 地球的自转导致昼夜交替。
words.en: The spinning of Earth around its own axis, which causes the alternation of day and night.

words.ex: The revolution of the earth takes one year.
words.ex_cn: 地球的公转需要一年时间。
words.en: The movement of the earth in its orbit around the sun, which takes about 365.25 days to complete, causing the cycle of seasons.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The moon feels the gravitational attraction of the earth.
words.ex_cn: 月球感受到地球的引力。
words.en: The force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.ex: The seism shook the city last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震袭击了这座城市。
words.en: An earthquake or earth tremor.

words.ex: The seismic wave shook the ground.
words.ex_cn: 地震波震动了地面。
words.en: Seismic means relating to or caused by an earthquake or earth vibration.

words.ex: The earthquake produced strong seismic waves.
words.ex_cn: 地震产生了强烈的地震波。
words.en: A seismic wave is an elastic wave generated by an impulse such as an earthquake or an explosion. Seismic waves can travel through the Earth's layers or along its surface.

words.ex: Penguins live at the south pole.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极。
words.en: The South Pole is the southernmost point on the Earth, lying diametrically opposite the North Pole.

words.ex: Polar bears live near the north pole.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极附近。
words.en: The North Pole is the northernmost point on the Earth, lying diametrically opposite the South Pole.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道把地球分成两个半球。
words.en: The imaginary line around the Earth at 0 degrees latitude, dividing the northern and southern hemispheres.

words.ex: The meridian line marks the center of the map.
words.ex_cn: 子午线标记地图的中心。
words.en: The meridian line is an imaginary line on the Earth's surface from the North Pole to the South Pole, used to indicate longitude.

words.tr:
v. 使翘棱；使扭曲变形
n. 弯曲；歪曲
words.ex: The heat will warp the metal.
words.ex_cn: 热量会使金属变形。
words.en: To warp is to bend or twist something out of its natural shape, often as a result of heat or moisture. It can also refer to the state of being bent or twisted.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The weft threads run horizontally in the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 纬线在织物中水平排列。
words.en: The weft is the threads that run horizontally across the loom in weaving, interlaced with the warp.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去非洲旅行。
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了欧洲。
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

words.ex: She moved to Australia last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.ex: He traveled to Oceania last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了大洋洲。
words.en: A region centered on the islands of the tropical Pacific Ocean.

words.ex: The ship crossed the Atlantic in ten days.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船用了十天时间横渡大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic refers to the Atlantic Ocean, which is the second largest ocean in the world, separating the Americas from Europe and Africa.

words.ex: The ship crosses the Atlantic Ocean every week.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船每周穿越大西洋。
words.en: The Atlantic Ocean is the second largest of the world's oceans, separating the Americas from Europe and Africa.

words.ex: The pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。
words.en: The Pacific Ocean is the body of water between the Americas to the east and Asia and Australia to the west. It is the largest ocean on Earth.

words.ex: The Pacific Ocean is very big.
words.ex_cn: 太平洋非常大。
words.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions, extending from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean in the south and bounded by Asia and Australia in the west and the Americas in the east.

words.ex: He swims in the Mediterranean every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都在地中海游泳。
words.en: The sea between Europe, Africa, and Asia, known for its warm climate and historical significance.

words.ex: He swims in the Mediterranean Sea every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都在地中海游泳。
words.en: The Mediterranean Sea is a sea connected to the Atlantic Ocean, surrounded by the Mediterranean Basin and almost completely enclosed by land: on the north by Southern Europe and Anatolia, on the south by North Africa, and on the east by the Levant.

words.ex: The marine birds fly over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海鸟在海面上飞翔。
words.en: Marine is used to describe things relating to the sea or to the ships and boats which sail on it.

words.ex: The small town has a maritime history.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着海洋历史。
words.en: Relating to the sea, especially in relation to seaborne trade or naval matters.

words.ex: The oceanic birds fly far over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这些海洋鸟类在海上飞得很远。
words.en: Relating to the ocean; vast or expansive in a way that suggests the ocean.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: The small village lies on the periphery of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于城市的外围。
words.en: The outer limits or edge of an area or object.

words.ex: The car stopped at the verge of the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在了道路的边缘。
words.en: The edge or border of something; to be close to a certain state or condition.

words.ex: The Strait of Malacca connects the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea.
words.ex_cn: 马六甲海峡连接印度洋和南海。
words.en: A strait is a narrow passage of water connecting two seas or two large areas of water.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: The Gulf of Mexico is a large sea area.
words.ex_cn: 墨西哥湾是一个大型海域。
words.en: A gulf is a large area of sea that is partly surrounded by land.

words.ex: The boat is parked in the bay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海湾里。
words.en: A bay is a body of water partially enclosed by land, typically smaller than a gulf. It can also refer to a compartment for a ship, the color of a horse, or the sound a dog makes.

words.ex: He lives on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个小岛上。
words.en: An island is a piece of land that is completely surrounded by water.

words.ex: The small isle is surrounded by blue sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海洋环绕着。
words.en: An isle is a small island.

words.ex: The small islet is surrounded by blue water.
words.ex_cn: 这个小岛被蓝色的海水环绕。
words.en: A very small island.

words.ex: The peninsula is surrounded by water on three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个半岛三面环水。
words.en: A peninsula is a piece of land that is almost entirely surrounded by water but is connected to the mainland on one side.

words.tr: phrase. 蛋白奶油蛋糕；浮岛
words.ex: She baked a floating island for the dessert table.
words.ex_cn: 她为甜点桌烤了一个蛋白奶油蛋糕。
words.en: A floating island is a mass of floating vegetation, mud, and peat, often found on lakes or rivers.

words.ex: The Philippines is an archipelago of thousands of islands.
words.ex_cn: 菲律宾是一个由数千个岛屿组成的群岛。
words.en: An archipelago is a group of islands, especially small islands, scattered in a body of water.

words.ex: Hawaii is a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean.
words.ex_cn: 夏威夷是太平洋中的一个火山岛。
words.en: An island that has been formed by volcanic activity.

words.ex: He visited a small coral island in the Pacific.
words.ex_cn: 他参观了太平洋上一个小小的珊瑚岛。
words.en: A coral island is an island that has been formed from coral.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.
