words.en: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relations of points, lines, surfaces, solids, and higher dimensional analogs.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.ex: He is learning probability theory in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在数学课上学习概率论。
words.en: Probability theory is a branch of mathematics concerned with the analysis of random phenomena. The central objects of probability theory are random variables, stochastic processes, and events: mathematical abstractions of non-deterministic events or measured quantities that may either be single occurrences or evolve over time in an apparently random fashion.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The triangle has three interior angles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三个内角。
words.en: An interior angle is an angle inside a shape, formed by two sides of the shape.

words.ex: The exterior angle is 120 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 外角是120度。
words.en: An exterior angle is an angle formed by one side of a polygon and the extension of an adjacent side.

words.ex: The triangle has an acute angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个锐角。
words.en: An acute angle is an angle that is less than 90 degrees. It is one of the basic types of angles in geometry.

words.ex: The triangle has an obtuse angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个钝角。
words.en: An angle that is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.ex: He drew a scalene triangle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个不等边三角形。
words.en: A scalene triangle is a triangle in which all three sides are of different lengths.

words.ex: The triangle has three equal sides, so it is an equilateral triangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条相等的边，所以它是一个等边三角形。
words.en: A triangle with all sides and angles equal.

words.ex: The triangle has two equal sides, so it is an isosceles triangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有两条相等的边，所以它是等腰三角形。
words.en: A triangle with at least two sides of equal length.

words.ex: The triangle has one right angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个直角。
words.en: A right-angled triangle is a triangle in which one angle is a right angle (that is, a 90-degree angle).

words.ex: The right triangle has one 90-degree angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个直角三角形有一个90度的角。
words.en: A right triangle is a triangle in which one angle is a right angle (90 degrees).

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.ex: The butterfly is symmetrical.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶是对称的。
words.en: Something that is symmetrical has parts that are equal in size, shape, and position, and that are arranged in a balanced way.

words.tr: phrase. 左右对称；两侧对称
words.ex: Butterflies have bilateral symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶具有两侧对称性。
words.en: Bilateral symmetry is the property of being divisible into symmetrical halves on either side of a unique plane.

words.tr:
adj. 四边的；四边形的
n. 四边形
words.ex: The quadrilateral shape has four sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个四边的形状有四条边。
words.en: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.ex: The child drew a tetragon on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个四边形。
words.en: A tetragon is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.tr: n. 四边形；四方院子；方形庭院
words.ex: The garden is shaped like a quadrangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园呈四边形。
words.en: A quadrangle is a four-sided plane figure, especially a square or rectangle. In architecture, it refers to a square or rectangular courtyard enclosed by buildings.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: The shape has four sides, and opposite sides are parallel; it is a parallelogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条边，对边平行；它是一个平行四边形。
words.en: A parallelogram is a four-sided plane rectilinear figure with opposite sides parallel.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.ex: He drew a five-pointed star on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个五角星。
words.en: A five-pointed star is a star with five points, typically having equal lengths and angles between the points, used as a symbol in various contexts.

words.tr: n. 梯形；不等边四边形
words.ex: The shape is a trapezoid with two parallel sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状是一个有两条平行边的梯形。
words.en: A flat shape with four straight sides, where one pair of opposite sides is parallel.

words.ex: The pyramid has four triangular faces and is a tetrahedron.
words.ex_cn: 这个金字塔有四个三角形面，是一个四面体。
words.en: A tetrahedron is a polyhedron composed of four triangular faces, three of which meet at each vertex.

words.ex: A cube is a hexahedron with six square faces.
words.ex_cn: 立方体是一个有六个正方形面的六面体。
words.en: A hexahedron is a polyhedron with six faces.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The box has a polyhedral shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子具有多面体的形状。
words.en: Having many plane faces or surfaces.

words.ex: A cube is a simple polyhedron.
words.ex_cn: 立方体是一个简单的多面体。
words.en: A polyhedron is a three-dimensional shape with flat faces and straight edges.

words.ex: A cube is a simple polytope.
words.ex_cn: 立方体是一个简单的多面体。
words.en: A polytope is a geometric figure with flat sides and straight edges, existing in any number of dimensions.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: v. 逐渐变细；逐渐减少；
words.ex: The candle tapers toward the top.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛向顶部逐渐变细。
words.en: A taper is a long thin candle or a gradual decrease in width or thickness.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.ex: The glass orb sat on the table.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃球放在桌子上。
words.en: An orb is a spherical object or shape, especially a celestial body like a planet or the moon.

words.tr: n. 球状体；回转椭圆体
words.ex: The earth is not a perfect sphere; it is a spheroid.
words.ex_cn: 地球不是一个完美的球体；它是一个椭球体。
words.en: A spheroid is a three-dimensional shape that is similar to a sphere but not perfectly round, often slightly flattened at the poles.

words.ex: The rock contains a small spherite.
words.ex_cn: 这块岩石中包含一个小球粒。
words.en: A small, spherical particle or granule, often found in minerals or synthetic materials.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.tr:
n. （火车等缓行时的）轧轧响声
v. 发出轧轧声
words.ex: The old train chugged slowly through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 那列旧火车缓缓驶过山区，发出轧轧声。
words.en: To move or make progress slowly and steadily, often with a regular sound.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley to carry the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他推着手推车来搬购物品。
words.en: A trolley is a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: The ship docked at the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbor is a place on the coast where ships may moor in shelter, especially one protected from rough water by piers, jetties, and other artificial structures.

words.ex: He rowed the boat across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着小船渡过湖面。
words.en: A boat is a small vehicle for travelling on water.

words.tr:
n. 船；舰；
v. 装运；
words.ex: The ship sailed across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 船驶过了海洋。
words.en: A ship is a large boat for travelling on water, especially across the sea.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.ex: He paddles a canoe on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着独木舟在湖上航行。
words.en: A canoe is a small, narrow boat that you move through the water using a paddle.

words.ex: He picked up the paddle and rowed the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起桨划船。
words.en: A paddle is a short pole with a wide flat part at one end or both ends, used to move a small boat through water.

words.tr:
n. 短桨；赛艇
v. 摇桨；划船
words.ex: He picked up the scull and rowed across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起短桨，划船穿过湖面。
words.en: A scull is a small oar used by a single rower, or the act of rowing with such oars.

words.ex: The beacon shines at night to guide ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发光以引导船只。
words.en: A beacon is a light or a fire, usually on a hill or tower, which acts as a signal or a warning.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: He drove on the turnpike to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他走收费公路以节省时间。
words.en: A turnpike is a road that drivers must pay to use, especially in the past. It is also a gate or barrier set across a road to stop traffic until a toll is paid.

words.tr:
n. 枢；中心；旋转
v. 在枢轴上转动；以…为中心
words.ex: The door pivots on a hinge.
words.ex_cn: 门围绕一个铰链旋转。
words.en: A pivot is the central point, pin, or shaft on which a mechanism turns or oscillates. It can also refer to the central or most important person or thing in a situation.

words.ex: Beijing is a transport hub in China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的交通中心。
words.en: A hub is the central part of a wheel, rotating on or with the axle, and from which the spokes radiate. It can also refer to a central point of activity or interest.

words.ex: The small town is located in the hinterland of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于该国的内地。
words.en: The area lying inland from a coast or the shore of a river; the backcountry.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.ex: The villagers gather at the market house to sell vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 村民们在市场聚集卖蔬菜。
words.en: A building or structure where goods are bought and sold, often located in a central area of a town or city.

words.ex: The marketplace is full of fresh fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 市场上摆满了新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: A marketplace is an area in a town where a public market is held, or a situation or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: The city hosted an exposition last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年夏天举办了一场博览会。
words.en: An exposition is a detailed explanation or description of an idea or theory. It can also refer to a large public exhibition of art or trade goods.

words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.tr: n. 物物交换；实物交易；
words.ex: They used barter to trade apples for eggs.
words.ex_cn: 他们用物物交换的方式用苹果换鸡蛋。
words.en: To trade goods or services without using money.

words.tr: n. 流动小贩；商贩；传播者
words.ex: The peddler sells toys on the street.
words.ex_cn: 小贩在街上卖玩具。
words.en: A peddler is someone who goes from place to place trying to sell small goods.

words.ex: The vendor sells fresh fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这个商贩在市场卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A vendor is a person or company that sells goods or services.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The retailer sells clothes to customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家零售商向顾客出售衣服。
words.en: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The retail trader sells clothes to customers in the market.
words.ex_cn: 零售商在市场里向顾客出售衣服。
words.en: A retail trader is a person or business that sells goods directly to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The car dealer sold me a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 汽车经销商卖给我一辆新自行车。
words.en: A dealer is a person whose business involves buying and selling things.

words.tr:
adj. 批发的；
n. 成批出售；
adv. 大批地；
words.ex: He buys clothes at wholesale prices.
words.ex_cn: 他以批发价购买衣服。
words.en: Wholesale is the business of buying and selling goods in large quantities, especially for resale to retailers.

words.ex: The wholesaler sells books to small shops.
words.ex_cn: 批发商把书卖给小商店。
words.en: A wholesaler is a person or company that sells goods in large quantities at low prices, typically to retailers.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.tr:
v. 征收；征税；征募
n. 征兵；征税
words.ex: The government will levy a new tax next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将征收一项新税。
words.en: To levy means to impose or collect a tax, fee, or fine. It can also refer to the act of enlisting or drafting individuals into military service.

words.tr:
n. 抵制；拒绝参加；
v. 抵制；拒绝参加；
words.ex: The students organized a boycott of the unfair school rule.
words.ex_cn: 学生们组织了对这项不公平校规的抵制。
words.en: If a country, group, or person boycotts a country, organization, or activity, they refuse to be involved with it in any way because they disapprove of it.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: He works in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业工作。
words.en: Industry is the work and processes involved in collecting raw materials, and making them into products in factories.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 大都市的；大城市的；
words.ex: He lives in a metropolitan city like New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约这样的大都市。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a metropolis or large city, especially as the main city of a country or region.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr: n. 大都市圈；集合城市
words.ex: The conurbation includes many nearby cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市群包括许多附近的城市。
words.en: A conurbation is a region comprising a number of cities, large towns, and other urban areas that, through population growth and physical expansion, have merged to form one continuous urban or industrially developed area.

words.ex: The municipal library is open every day.
words.ex_cn: 这座市政图书馆每天都开放。
words.en: Relating to a city or town or its governing body.

words.ex: The municipality cleaned the streets last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个自治市上周清理了街道。
words.en: A municipality is a city or town that has its own government to manage local affairs.

words.ex: The urbanite walks to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市居民每天步行上班。
words.en: An urbanite is a person who lives in a city or town.

words.ex: He volunteers for civic projects in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他为家乡的市民项目做志愿者。
words.en: Relating to a city or town, especially its administration; relating to the duties or activities of people in relation to their town, city, or local area.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: The civilian population stayed safe during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 平民在冲突期间保持安全。
words.en: A civilian is a person who is not a member of the military or of a police or firefighting force.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.ex: The cave dweller lives alone in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 洞穴居民独自住在山里。
words.en: A dweller is a person or animal that lives in or at a specified place.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: The city improved its sewerage system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改进了其排水系统。
words.en: The system of removing waste water and human excrement from homes and other buildings, and the waste material that is removed.

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.tr: phrase. 公用事业；公共设施
words.ex: The city pays for public utilities like water and electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市为水和电力等公共事业付费。
words.en: Public utilities are services provided to the public, such as electricity, water, and gas, often by government or private companies under government regulation.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: Many families live in a small tenement in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市里的一间廉价公寓里。
words.en: A tenement is a large old building which is divided into a number of individual flats.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: She sells handmade handicraft at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上出售手工制品。
words.en: Handicraft refers to activities where useful and decorative objects are made completely by hand or by using only simple tools.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.ex: The artisan makes handmade pottery.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠制作手工陶器。
words.en: An artisan is someone who makes things by hand, especially using traditional methods.

words.ex: She sells articles of handicraft art at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 她在本地市场出售手工艺品。
words.en: Items created by skilled manual work, often with aesthetic value, considered as art.

words.tr: n. 手工艺；手工艺品；“handicraft”的复数
words.ex: She sells handmade handicrafts at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上出售手工制品。
words.en: Handicrafts are objects that are made by hand, often using traditional methods, and are usually considered to be artistic or cultural.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: The trainee is learning how to use the machine.
words.ex_cn: 这位受训者正在学习如何使用这台机器。
words.en: A trainee is someone who is being taught how to do a particular job.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: The potter fired the clay in a kiln.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把陶土放在窑里烧制。
words.en: A kiln is a type of oven that is used to bake clay and pottery in order to make them hard.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.tr:
n. 锻造术
v. 锻造；“smith”的现在分词
words.ex: He is learning smithing from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向父亲学习锻铁技艺。
words.en: The craft or occupation of a smith; the work of shaping metal, especially by forging.

words.tr:
n. 锤击；锤打声
v. 锤击；敲打；“hammer”的的现在分词
words.ex: The hammering of the nails woke up the baby.
words.ex_cn: 钉钉子的锤击声吵醒了婴儿。
words.en: The act of hitting something repeatedly with a hammer.

words.tr: n. 锻造；打铁；“blacksmith”的现在分词
words.ex: He practices blacksmithing in his small workshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在自己的小作坊里练习打铁。
words.en: Blacksmithing is the craft of forging iron into useful or ornamental objects.

words.ex: The blacksmith makes horseshoes with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠用锤子打马蹄铁。
words.en: A blacksmith is a person who makes and repairs things in iron by hand.

words.ex: He is a silversmith who makes beautiful rings.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位制作精美戒指的银匠。
words.en: A silversmith is a craftsman who makes objects out of silver.

words.ex: The coppersmith made a pot from copper.
words.ex_cn: 铜匠用铜做了一个锅。
words.en: A coppersmith is a person who makes and repairs things made of copper.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: She cooked many delicious dishes for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对做了许多美味的菜肴。
words.en: Plates, bowls, cups, etc., used for serving and eating food, or the food served in them.

words.tr: n. 碗；一碗…；碗状物；“bowl”的复数；
words.ex: She washed the bowls after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了碗。
words.en: Bowls are round, deep dishes used for holding food or liquid. The game of bowls involves rolling a ball towards a target.

words.ex: She put the kettle on to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。
words.en: A kettle is a container or device in which water is boiled, having a lid, spout, and handle, used for making tea or coffee.

words.ex: He poured water into the tub.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进了桶里。
words.en: A tub is a large, open container that you fill with water and use to wash yourself or to wash clothes.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He filled the pail with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A pail is a bucket, usually made of metal or plastic, with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He bought a keg of beer for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一小桶啤酒。
words.en: A keg is a small barrel used for storing and transporting liquids, especially beer.

words.tr: n. 便桶；小衣橱；洗脸台
words.ex: He cleaned the commode after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他使用完便桶后就把它打扫了。
words.en: A commode is a piece of furniture that usually has drawers and is used for storing clothes, or a chair with a container in it that is used as a toilet.

words.ex: The old train station had cuspidors on every wall.
words.ex_cn: 旧火车站的每面墙上都有痰盂。
words.en: A cuspidor is a bowl-shaped container, often made of metal or ceramic, used as a receptacle for spit, especially by people chewing tobacco.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: He poured milk from a jug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个水壶里倒牛奶。
words.en: A jug is a container used for holding and pouring liquids. It typically has a handle and a spout for easy pouring.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.tr:
n. 凿子
v. 雕；凿；欺骗
words.ex: He used a chisel to carve the stone.
words.ex_cn: 他用凿子雕刻石头。
words.en: A chisel is a tool with a long metal blade which has a sharp edge for cutting wood, stone, or metal.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: The farmer uses an auger to drill holes in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 农夫使用螺旋钻在地里钻孔。
words.en: An auger is a tool consisting of a rotating helical shaft used to move material or drill holes.

words.ex: He used pincers to pull out the nail.
words.ex_cn: 他用钳子把钉子拔出来。
words.en: Pincers are a tool with two parts that are used for holding or pulling things, especially by squeezing them together.

words.ex: He used pliers to fix the broken wire.
words.ex_cn: 他用钳子修理了断掉的电线。
words.en: Pliers are a tool with two handles at one end and two hard, flat, metal parts at the other. Pliers are used to hold small things or to bend and cut wire.

words.ex: He used tongs to pick up the hot bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹子夹起热面包。
words.en: A tool consisting of two movable arms joined at one end, used for picking up and holding things.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.ex: The company changed its tack after the market crash.
words.ex_cn: 公司在市场崩盘后改变了行动方针。
words.en: A tack is a short nail with a broad, flat head, used especially for fastening carpets. As a verb, it can mean to fasten something with tacks or to change the direction of a sailing ship.

words.ex: He drew out a nail from the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头里拔出了一颗钉子。
words.en: To remove a nail by pulling it out, typically using a tool like pliers or a claw hammer.

words.ex: He pulled out a nail from the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他从木头上拔出了一颗钉子。
words.en: To remove a nail by pulling it out, typically with a tool like a hammer or pliers.

words.tr: phrase. 把一颗钉子敲进去
words.ex: He drives in a nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把钉子敲进去。
words.en: To hammer a nail into something, such as wood, in order to fasten or attach it.

words.tr: phrase. 把一颗钉子敲进去
words.ex: He hammered in a nail to hang the picture.
words.ex_cn: 他敲进一颗钉子来挂画。
words.en: To drive a nail into a surface using a hammer.

words.tr: phrase. 把一颗钉子敲进去
words.ex: He knocks in a nail to hang the picture.
words.ex_cn: 他敲进一颗钉子来挂照片。
words.en: To drive a nail into something by hitting it with a hammer.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: She rolled out the paste for the pie crust.
words.ex_cn: 她把面团擀平做派皮。
words.en: Paste is a soft, wet, sticky mixture of a powder and a liquid, which can be spread easily. It is also used to refer to the action of sticking something onto a surface using a sticky substance.

words.tr:
n. 膨胀；凸出部分；暴涨
v. 膨胀；凸出；急增
words.ex: The balloon begins to bulge when filled with air.
words.ex_cn: 气球充气时开始鼓起来。
words.en: If something bulges, it sticks out or swells in a rounded shape.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The nail protrudes from the wood.
words.ex_cn: 钉子从木头里凸出来。
words.en: If something protrudes from somewhere, it sticks out.

words.ex: The spoon has a concave surface.
words.ex_cn: 勺子有一个凹的表面。
words.en: A concave surface is curved inward, like the inside of a bowl.

words.tr: v. 削弱； adj. “dent”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The scandal dented his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻削弱了他的声誉。
words.en: If something is dented, its surface has been pushed in or damaged, often by being hit.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.ex: The carpenter carved a tenon to fit into the mortise.
words.ex_cn: 木匠雕刻了一个榫头，以插入卯眼。
words.en: A tenon is a projecting piece of wood made for insertion into a mortise in another piece.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: She weaves a basket from reeds.
words.ex_cn: 她用芦苇编织一个篮子。
words.en: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a machine or a frame called a loom.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.tr:
n. 纬纱；纬线；织物
int. 汪汪（狗叫声）
words.ex: The weaver pulled the woof through the warp.
words.ex_cn: 织工将纬纱穿过经纱。
words.en: The sound made by a dog, or to make such a sound.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.tr:
n. 布帘；垂下的褶皱状
v. 盖上褶缀的布；将（织物）悬挂；懒散地垂着
words.ex: The blue drape covered the window completely.
words.ex_cn: 蓝色的布帘完全遮住了窗户。
words.en: To drape something means to arrange it in a loose, flowing way, especially fabric or clothing.

words.ex: The floor has a colorful mosaic of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一个五彩的花卉镶嵌图案。
words.en: A mosaic is a picture or pattern produced by arranging together small colored pieces of hard material, such as stone, tile, or glass.

words.tr: n. 亚麻毛织品；棉毛织品
words.ex: She wore a linsey-woolsey dress to the old-fashioned fair.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件林赛-伍尔西面料的裙子去参加复古集市。
words.en: A coarse fabric made from a mix of linen and wool.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: He grows flax in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里种植亚麻。
words.en: Flax is a plant with blue flowers. Its stem is used for making linen and its seeds are used for making linseed oil.

words.ex: He wore a shirt made of coarse cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件用粗糙布料做的衬衫。
words.en: Coarse cloth refers to a type of fabric that is rough and not fine, often used for making work clothes or other items that require durability.

words.ex: She wore a dress made of homespun cloth.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条用自织布料做的裙子。
words.en: Homespun cloth refers to a type of fabric that is woven by hand at home, typically characterized by its simple, rustic appearance.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.ex: The bridge holds up with a strong steel cable.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥靠一根坚固的钢缆支撑。
words.en: A steel cable is a type of cable made from steel, used for lifting or supporting heavy objects.

words.ex: He tied the box with hemp rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用大麻绳把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: Hemp rope is a type of rope made from the fibers of the hemp plant, known for its strength and durability.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: The light bulb has a thin filament.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡有一根细灯丝。
words.en: A filament is a very thin thread or fiber of natural or artificial material.

words.ex: She spun wool into yarn to make a sweater.
words.ex_cn: 她把羊毛纺成纱线来织毛衣。
words.en: Yarn is a long, continuous length of interlocked fibers, suitable for use in the production of textiles, sewing, crocheting, knitting, weaving, embroidery, or ropemaking.

words.tr:
v. 使滞留；使搁浅；
n. 方面；
words.ex: The storm stranded the travelers on the island.
words.ex_cn: 风暴使旅行者滞留在岛上。
words.en: If someone is stranded, they are left in a place that is difficult for them to get away from. A strand of something such as hair, wire, or thread is a single thin piece of it.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: She picked up the coil of rope from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 她从地上捡起了那卷绳子。
words.en: A coil is a length of something wound in a joined sequence of loops, or the act of winding something into loops.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.ex: She bought some earthenware pots at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一些陶器。
words.en: Earthenware is pottery that has not been fired to the point of vitrification and is thus porous and coarser than porcelain or stoneware.

words.ex: The shop sells handmade ware like pots and cups.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售陶罐和杯子等手工艺品。
words.en: Objects or goods made of a particular material or for a particular use.

words.tr: n. 制陶艺术；制陶工艺；
words.ex: He learned ceramics from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里学习了制陶艺术。
words.en: The art of making objects by shaping pieces of clay and then baking them until they are hard.

words.ex: The potter made a clay bowl by hand.
words.ex_cn: 陶工用手制作了一个陶碗。
words.en: A potter is someone who makes pottery, and to potter means to busy oneself in a desultory but pleasant manner.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.tr: n. 炻器；粗陶器；缸瓦器
words.ex: He bought a stoneware bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶器碗。
words.en: Stoneware is a type of pottery that is fired at a high temperature and is nonporous and opaque.

words.ex: He bought a cup made of redware at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个红陶做的杯子。
words.en: A type of pottery that is characterized by its red color, often used for making dishes, pots, and other household items.

words.tr:
v. 上釉；上玻璃；浇浆汁于；变呆滞
n. 釉料；光滑面；覆罩的一层
words.ex: The potter glazes the clay bowl before firing it.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠在烧制前给陶碗上釉。
words.en: To glaze means to fit panes of glass into a window frame or similar structure. It can also refer to the process of applying a glossy, often transparent, coating to pottery or other materials.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.ex: He kneads dough every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上揉面团。
words.en: To knead is to press and stretch dough or another substance with your hands in order to make it smooth and ready to use.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: The pigment in leaves changes color in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 叶子中的色素在秋天会变色。
words.en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular color.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: He engraves his name on the ring.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在戒指上。
words.en: To engrave means to cut or carve a design or letters into a hard surface, or to be strongly impressed in someone's memory.

words.ex: The motif of love appears in many poems.
words.ex_cn: 爱的主题出现在许多诗歌中。
words.en: A motif is a design or pattern that is used in a piece of art or music, or a theme that is repeated in a work of literature.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.ex: He is an icon of pop music.
words.ex_cn: 他是流行音乐的偶像。
words.en: An icon is a small picture or symbol on a computer screen that represents a program or a file.

words.ex: The limner painted small portraits for the king.
words.ex_cn: 这位画师为国王画了小型肖像。
words.en: A limner is someone who paints or draws, especially in a detailed or meticulous manner.

words.ex: He is a connoisseur of fine wine.
words.ex_cn: 他是优质葡萄酒的行家。
words.en: A connoisseur is a person who is especially competent to pass critical judgments in an art, particularly one of the fine arts, or in matters of taste.

words.tr: n. 赞助人；资助人；老主顾
words.ex: The patron gave money to support the art exhibition.
words.ex_cn: 赞助人捐钱支持了这场艺术展览。
words.en: A patron is a person who supports with money, gifts, efforts, or endorsement an artist, musician, writer, form of art, or charitable cause.

words.ex: The company received patronage from a local businessman.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司收到了一位本地商人的赞助。
words.en: The support, encouragement, privilege, or financial aid that an organization or individual bestows to another.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: He supports radicalism to change the system.
words.ex_cn: 他支持激进主义来改变制度。
words.en: Radicalism is the belief or behavior of people who advocate thorough or complete political or social reform.

words.ex: He supports conservatism because he likes traditional values.
words.ex_cn: 他支持保守主义，因为他喜欢传统价值观。
words.en: Conservatism is a political and social philosophy promoting traditional social institutions in the context of culture and civilization.

words.ex: He is a doubter who questions everything.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个质疑一切的怀疑者。
words.en: A doubter is a person who is uncertain or lacks conviction about something.

words.tr:
n. 不可知论者
adj. 不可知论的
words.ex: He is agnostic about religion.
words.ex_cn: 他对宗教持不可知论态度。
words.en: An agnostic is someone who believes that it is not possible to know whether God exists or not.

words.tr:
adj. 不信宗教的；异教徒的；不信仰的
n. 异教徒
words.ex: He is an infidel who never goes to church.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个从不去教堂的不信宗教的人。
words.en: An infidel is a person who does not believe in a religion that someone regards as the true religion.

words.tr:
n. 异教徒；无宗教信仰者
adj. 异教的；异教徒的；无宗教信仰的
words.ex: He lived in a pagan village long ago.
words.ex_cn: 他很久以前住在一个异教村庄里。
words.en: A pagan is someone who worships many gods or no god, especially one who belongs to a religion that existed before Christianity.

words.tr: n. 怀疑论者；怀疑宗教主张的人；无神论者
words.ex: He is a skeptic about new health claims.
words.ex_cn: 他对新的健康说法持怀疑态度。
words.en: A skeptic is a person who questions the validity or authenticity of something purporting to be factual.

words.tr: n. 愤世嫉俗者；悲观者；怀疑者
words.ex: He is a cynic who never believes in good intentions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个不相信任何善意的愤世嫉俗者。
words.en: A cynic is someone who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: He believes in anarchism and wants no government.
words.ex_cn: 他相信无政府主义，想要没有政府。
words.en: Anarchism is the political belief that there should be little or no formal or official organization to society but that people should work freely together.

words.ex: The country still has a monarchy with a king as the head of state.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家仍然实行君主制，国王是国家元首。
words.en: A monarchy is a form of government in which a country is ruled by a monarch, such as a king or queen.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: The democrats won the election last year.
words.ex_cn: 民主党去年赢得了选举。
words.en: The Democratic Party in the United States, often referred to as a collective political entity.

words.ex: The republicans won the election last year.
words.ex_cn: 共和党人去年赢得了选举。
words.en: The Republicans refers to members or supporters of the Republican Party, one of the two major contemporary political parties in the United States, the other being its historic rival, the Democratic Party.

words.ex: The federal government pays for public schools.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府为公立学校提供资金。
words.en: The federal government is the national government of a federation, which is a political entity characterized by a union of partially self-governing provinces, states, or other regions under a central federal government.

words.tr: phrase. 美国独立战争；美国革命
words.ex: The American Revolution started in 1775.
words.ex_cn: 美国独立战争始于1775年。
words.en: The American Revolution refers to the political upheaval during the last half of the 18th century in which the Thirteen Colonies in North America joined together to break free from the British Empire, combining to become the United States of America.

words.tr: phrase. 美国独立战争（1775–1783年），北美十三个殖民地为脱离英国统治、争取独立而进行的战争
words.ex: The American Revolutionary War ended in 1783.
words.ex_cn: 美国独立战争于1783年结束。
words.en: The American Revolutionary War, also known as the American War of Independence, was a conflict between Great Britain and its thirteen North American colonies, which had declared themselves the independent United States of America.

words.tr: phrase. 美国内战；南北战争
words.ex: The civil war lasted for four years.
words.ex_cn: 这场内战持续了四年。
words.en: A war between citizens of the same country.

words.ex: Many people lost their jobs during the great depression.
words.ex_cn: 在大萧条期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: The Great Depression was a severe worldwide economic depression that took place mostly during the 1930s, originating in the United States.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The migrant found a new job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移居者在城市里找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A migrant is a person who moves from one place to another, especially in order to find work.

words.ex: He is an emigrant from China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自中国的移民。
words.en: An emigrant is a person who leaves their own country to live permanently in another country.

words.tr: n. 殖民者；殖民地居民；移民
words.ex: The colonist built a small house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这位殖民者在河边建了一座小房子。
words.en: A colonist is a person who settles in a new colony or moves to live in a new country.

words.ex: The majority of students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: The majority is the greater number or part of something.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.ex: My ancestors came from China long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先很久以前来自中国。
words.en: Your ancestors are the people from whom you are descended.

words.ex: Our forefathers built this city long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我们的祖先很久以前建造了这座城市。
words.en: Your forefathers are your ancestors, especially your male ancestors.

words.ex: The ancient hunter is the progenitor of our family.
words.ex_cn: 这位古代猎人是我们家族的祖先。
words.en: A progenitor is a direct ancestor of someone or the originator of a particular idea or movement.

words.tr:
n. 祖宗；“forbear”的复数
v. 克制；容忍；“forbear”的第三人称单数
words.ex: My forbears came from Ireland.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先来自爱尔兰。
words.en: Your forbears are your ancestors, the people from whom you are descended.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: The young manager is the successor to the CEO.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻经理是首席执行官的接班人。
words.en: A successor is a person who takes a job or position previously held by someone else.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: The old tree produced many progeny.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树生了许多后代。
words.en: The offspring or descendants considered as a group.

words.ex: He is the inheritor of his father's farm.
words.ex_cn: 他是他父亲农场的继承人。
words.en: An inheritor is a person who inherits something; a heir.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他们的书在桌子上。
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: He traced his lineage back to ancient kings.
words.ex_cn: 他追溯了自己的家系到古代的国王。
words.en: Your lineage is the series of families from which you are directly descended.

words.ex: He learned about his ancestry from his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖母那里了解了自己的血统。
words.en: Your ancestry is the series of ancestors from whom you are descended.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日期间点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: The adaptation of animals to cold weather is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 动物对寒冷天气的适应令人惊叹。
words.en: An adaptation is a film, television drama, or stage play that is based on a written work.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: The survival of the animals depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这些动物的生存取决于天气。
words.en: The state or fact of continuing to live or exist, typically in spite of an accident, ordeal, or difficult circumstances.

words.ex: In nature, survival of the fittest means the strongest animals live longer.
words.ex_cn: 在自然界中，适者生存意味着最强壮的动物活得更久。
words.en: The principle that only the organisms best adapted to their environment tend to survive and transmit their genetic characteristics to succeeding generations.

words.ex: The zoo protects endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 动物园保护濒危动物。
words.en: Animals that are at risk of becoming extinct due to factors such as habitat loss, poaching, and climate change.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.tr: n. 商机；理想的工作或生活；
words.ex: He found a niche in selling eco-friendly phone cases.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售环保手机壳方面找到了商机。
words.en: A niche is a hollow area in a wall which has been made to hold a statue, or a comfortable or suitable position in life or employment.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: The forest is home to a rich fauna.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是丰富动物群的家园。
words.en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.tr: phrase. 生物多样性；生物差异
words.ex: The forest has high biological diversity.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林具有很高的生物多样性。
words.en: The variety of life in the world or in a particular habitat or ecosystem.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: The sun gives out ultraviolet radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出紫外线辐射。
words.en: Ultraviolet radiation is a type of energy produced by the sun and some artificial sources, which can cause damage to the skin and eyes.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: The river is contaminated by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: To contaminate something means to make it impure or polluted by contact or mixture with something unclean or harmful.

words.ex: The river suffered from contamination after the factory dumped waste.
words.ex_cn: 工厂倾倒废物后，这条河受到了污染。
words.en: The process of making something dirty or polluted, or the state of being dirty or polluted.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.ex: The smoke from the factory is noxious.
words.ex_cn: 工厂的烟雾是有害的。
words.en: Something that is noxious is harmful or poisonous.

words.ex: The water is toxic to fish.
words.ex_cn: 这种水对鱼是有毒的。
words.en: If a substance is toxic, it is poisonous.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.ex: The disposal of waste material must follow local rules.
words.ex_cn: 废物的处理必须遵守当地规定。
words.en: The act or process of getting rid of unwanted or unusable substances, especially in an environmentally safe way.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.ex: The sound pollution from the road keeps me awake at night.
words.ex_cn: 道路上的噪音污染让我晚上睡不着。
words.en: Sound pollution refers to harmful or annoying levels of noise, as from vehicles, industry, etc., considered as a form of environmental pollution.

words.ex: The noise was 80 decibels.
words.ex_cn: 噪音是80分贝。
words.en: A decibel is a unit used to measure the intensity of a sound or the power level of an electrical signal by comparing it with a given level on a logarithmic scale.
